objective: Ensure each explicit screenshot chat turn uses only the latest fresh semantic observation, fail closed on leaked prompt/reasoning text, retire the unused local OCR product path, and report truthful current plus peak VRAM measurements with their source.
non_goals: Do not increase Hina's runtime context beyond 8,192 tokens in this slice; document the measured 50K cost and keep a later benchmark/promotion gate.

Do not replace or fine-tune OmniVoice, download an unreviewed community checkpoint, run an all-on soak, persist model telemetry, retain screenshots, or expose prompts, hidden reasoning, API keys, raw model payloads or image pixels.

Do not make Cloud vision resident locally, invent per-model VRAM values when a provider cannot attribute shared-process memory, or bypass scheduler admission and the owner-approved 15,872 MiB ceiling.
contracts: A fresh screenshot turn composes at most one newest same-session semantic observation and excludes prior short-term turns that were produced from another fresh screenshot; ordinary conversation turns remain available.

The final output boundary truncates a valid Vietnamese answer before any internal UNTRUSTED_* sentinel or bounded English meta-narration and rejects an output whose first content is internal-only; leaked material never reaches moderation replay memory UI or TTS.
Local OCR is no longer constructible, selectable, force-loadable, advertised or installed by the Hina product; explicit screen understanding uses the selected Vision provider.

Each resource row separates scheduler reservation from provider-reported current VRAM, provider peak and dashboard-session sampled peak, and names the measurement source or a bounded unavailable reason instead of substituting a configured estimate.

Cloud vision reports exact zero local model VRAM. Ollama brain current VRAM comes from /api/ps size_vram. OmniVoice current and peak come from its CUDA allocator telemetry. Faster-Whisper remains unknown per-model when its shared native process cannot provide exact attribution.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Python standard library, Vue 3/TypeScript, Electron typed preload, Ollama local API and repository test tooling; no new runtime dependency.
acceptance_criteria: A two-capture regression proves the second model prompt contains the new observation and current question but not the previous screenshot-derived user/assistant pair.

A response shaped like the owner screenshot yields only the user-facing answer and contains no Wait/I need context narration, UNTRUSTED_FRESH_OBSERVATION_DATA, analysis heading or hidden reasoning in replay.
OCR controls, runtime construction, resource row, dependency, active provenance/model manifest and product tests are removed; Vision capture remains runnable.
The Resources page labels current and peak VRAM plus source accurately and preserves null with a clear reason when exact attribution is unavailable.

Documentation gives a formula-backed 50K KV-cache estimate for the installed Qwen3-VL 8B metadata, records that 8,192 remains the promoted runtime context, summarizes official OmniVoice successor status and records regular GitNexus use.
Narrow text-brain, perception, resource, desktop typecheck/build tests and one repository fast gate pass with no agent-created raw media or benchmark artifact retained.
